scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile --force && bun install --cwd rust-js --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun scripts/apply-compiler-patches.ts
scripts.test:browser: bun run compile && bunx --bun playwright test
scripts.test:calendar: bun scripts/build-core-probe.ts crates/core/src/foundation/date/plain_date.rs && UI_SDK_CALENDAR_PROBE=1 bun test tests/calendar.test.ts
scripts.test:details: bun scripts/build-core-probe.ts crates/core/src/foundation/kernel/details.rs && UI_SDK_DETAILS_PROBE=1 bun test tests/change-source.test.ts
scripts.test:projection: bun scripts/build-core-probe.ts crates/core/src/foundation/motion/projection.rs && UI_SDK_PROJECTION_PROBE=1 bun test tests/projection.test.ts
